_comment: Mock bodies for the three real endpoints (/routes/, /stops/, /stops/<id>),
served by tools/gate.py's local HTTP server via URL substitution -- see
gate.py's module docstring for why this is done by injection rather than
a fixture-mode branch inside nycsubway.star itself.
Verified (Task 5 review) to render at 0/2048 whole-frame diff against
'estimated_current_stop_arrival_time' is written here as a relative
'arrival_offset' (seconds from serve-time) rather than an absolute unix
time, since a fixture with a baked-in past timestamp would immediately
read as stale. gate.py resolves it to int(time.time()) + offset when the
mock server answers a /stops/<id> request. 30s ('now' bucket) and
N*60+30 (an 'N min' bucket) are used everywhere so render latency can
never flip which minute bucket format_arrival() lands in.
destination_stop 'G21' deliberately does NOT use the live API's own name
for that stop ('Queens Plaza') -- the reference frame shows 'QUEENS', so
this fixture's stops list overrides it to 'Queens'. That only affects
which marquee text renders; it never touches the render path itself.
